names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 11 octombrie, «Sfântul Ierarh Teofan Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Niceei».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 11 Οκτωβρίου, «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας», with the rank words left off; the epithet «ο Γραπτός», the branded, is the page's own.
The bare name out of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2256, headed «Исповедник Феофан Никейский, Константинопольский», with the rank word and the two epithets left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 11. октобар ст. ст., „Преп. Теофан Начертани.“ — Преп. is the venerable grade this corpus puts in `types` and comes off. **Начертани is kept**, because it is not a rank: it is the Graptos of the two brothers whose faces were written on, which is what tells this Theophanes from the others, and §6 says to keep a by-name the heading itself gives. `foldchk.py` measured the bare string as held by `theophanes-the-confessor-9-september` alone before this day; the fuller form stored here folds to `теофан начертани` and `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for it, so no fold is created — measured both ways.

death.note: Two books give two years and neither is preferred. The Russian calendar’s day line prints «(ок. 850)» and the first of its two lives for him closes «Скончался преподобный в мире около 850 года». The Ohrid Prologue for the Julian 11 October says «Мирно скончао 847. год.», 847 flat. The interval spans both. Neither saint.gr nor doxologia.ro was read for a year, and the Prologue’s other two numbers — twenty-five years of suffering for the icons and a hundred and forty-five canons — are a duration and a count of works, and neither is a date.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 11 октября ст. ст. — «Прп. Феофана Исповедника, творца канонов, еп. Никейского (ок. 850).»
source.note: The rank is the alt text of the second of the day's two icons, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» — the plain service — which stands immediately before his line. The first icon, of the same kind, stands before the apostle Philip at the head of the paragraph, and the two lines after his carry none.

attestations.note: The day line is a whole description where the Greek gave a name: «Исповедника, творца канонов, еп. Никейского (ок. 850)» — confessor, maker of canons, bishop of Nicaea, about 850 — and the folder's `dates`, office and types all come from it and from the two lives behind it. The site's own two accounts disagree about his brother: the first dates Theodore the Graptos's death in prison to about 833 and the second to about 840. That is a disagreement about a man this corpus does not hold, so it is recorded here and nowhere else.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 11 octombrie — «Sfântul Ierarh Teofan Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Niceei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 11ης Οκτωβρίου — «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the brother of Theodore the Branded, learned in the Scriptures and in the ancient Greek writers, who buried his brother in 838 and was afterwards exiled to Thessalonica, and whom the patriarch Methodius made metropolitan of Nicaea after the death of the iconoclast emperor Theophilus. The page gives 838 for the burial of his brother and no year for his own death, so no `dates` object is proposed. It records a portion of his relic at the monastery of Prousos in Eurytania. It prints a proper apolytikion naming him and a kontakion naming him, both taken here, and an «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον», the common of a teacher of Orthodoxy with his name in it, which is not drafted. Its Theodore the Branded, referred to 27 Δεκεμβρίου, has no folder in the corpus, so he is named in the added paragraph and not linked. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 24.10.2026 (11. октобар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Теофан Начертани.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry. The heading is quoted whole, with the closing full stop the Prologue itself prints, which is what BRIEF-SERBIAN section 4 asks for. It had to be measured off the raw cached page, because srbody.mjs and sr-cand.mjs both strip it from their printed output: every heading of this day ends ". " in the source. THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE EPITHET AND THE BROTHER TOGETHER. Начертани is the Graptos of the two brothers whose faces were written on, and the entry names the brother — Теодором (27. дец.) — whom this folder already relates as `theodore-brother-of-theophanes`. Confessor, canon-writer, the monastery of Sabbas the Sanctified, the mission to the emperor, the prison, the branding and the bishopric after iconoclasm ended: one man, and the folder is his. `dates` WIDENED, AND IT IS THE DAY’S ONLY FIELD CHANGE. The folder held `death` 850 flat, displayed «c. 850», off the Russian day line’s «(ок. 850)» and its life’s «около 850 года». **This entry says «Мирно скончао 847. год.»**, 847 flat. Two books, two years, neither preferred, so the interval is widened to carry both and chooses neither — 847 or about 850, which is the «X or Y» shape the corpus already writes as «285 or about 288». **THE OTHER TWO NUMBERS IN THE ENTRY ARE REFUSED AND BOTH REFUSALS HAVE NAMES.** «Страдао за иконе 25 година» is a **duration**, and a duration is refused and may not be subtracted from anything; «Написао 145 канона» is a count of works and no field holds it. Both are in the prose as what the book says. `types` UNTOUCHED at `hierarch`, `bishop`, `confessor`, `hymnographer`: Преп. and Исповедник corroborate, «писац канона» corroborates the `hymnographer`, and **the entry’s own ordination is a verb in the body** — «ускоро посвећен за епископа», consecrated bishop — which is no warrant for a rank and in any case says no see. `office` left at «Bishop of Nicaea»: **this entry does not name Nicaea at all**, and a scalar field is not touched on a book’s silence. `related` UNTOUCHED: `theodore-brother-of-theophanes` is already there. **The patriarch Thomas of Jerusalem takes no row** — nothing read here identifies him with any folder and he is the man who sent them, not a companion; the emperors Leo the Armenian and Theophilus are emperors in a life. No `locations`. NO FOLD, AND THE BY-NAME IS THE WHOLE REASON. `foldchk.py` measured the bare «Теофан» before the day as `foldchk.py` returning `theophanes-the-confessor-9-september` and nothing else — a venerable confessor born in 283 and dead about 300, kept on 9 September, five and a half centuries off. **Section 6 says to keep a by-name the heading itself gives**, and this heading gives Начертани, which is no rank but the Graptos that tells this Theophanes from every other. So the form stored is «Теофан Начертани», it folds to `теофан начертани` (`nameKeys` sorts the words), `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for it, and **no fold is created and no READ_FOLDS key is owed** — measured both ways before drafting, which is what section 6 was written for. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. THE DAY’S SECOND ENTRY IS REFUSED AND IT IS NOT A CLOSE CALL. «Спомен Седмог Васељенског Сабора.» — **a Council is not a folder**, and the entry is about the Council and not about a person: Nicaea in 787 under the empress Irene and her son Constantine and the patriarch Tarasius, 367 Fathers, the definition of the veneration of icons out of Scripture, the Fathers and attested wonders, and the ruling that relics of martyrs must be put into the antimension. It names the bishop Constantine of Cyprus, who told the Council the story of the shepherd of Constantia who struck the Mother of God’s icon with his iron staff, spoiled the right eye of the image, stumbled on leaving and put out his own right eye with the same staff. **None of those takes a row and none is in any prose of this day**: the Fathers of a Council are not a folder, an emperor in an entry is not a relation, and the subject of an anecdote told at a Council is further still from one. `tarasius-of-constantinople` has a folder and gets nothing from this day. §6’S TRAP, MET AND FIXED §6’S WAY. The appended paragraph first read «the monastery of Saint Sabbas the Sanctified», which is a folder’s display name exactly, and `related-floor.test.mjs` failed 483/2 on it in both directions. **A monastery is a house and not a companion** — the two brothers were tonsured there three centuries after its founder died — so the `related` rows the test asked for would both have been false, and nothing was added to `scripts/related-floor-exclusions.json`. The prose now reads «the monastery of Saint Sabbas in Palestine», which matches no display name in the corpus, and the house keeps the book’s own words here: the Prologue says the brothers were tonsured «у манастиру Св. Саве Освештаног», in the monastery of Saint Sabbas the Sanctified.

hymns.text: Îndreptătorule al Ortodoxiei, învățătorule al dreptei cinstiri de Dumnezeu şi al curăției şi luminătorule al lumii, podoaba călugărilor cea de Dumnezeu insuflată Sfinte Părinte Teofan, înțelepte, cu învățăturile tale pe toți i-ai luminat. Alăută duhovnicească, roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Teofan Mărturisitorul, Episcopul Niceei

english.text: O guide of Orthodoxy, teacher of true reverence for God and of purity, luminary of the world, God-inspired adornment of monks: O wise father Theophanes, by thy teachings thou hast enlightened all. O spiritual harp, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Μυηθεῖς τῶν Ἀγγέλων Πάτερ τὸ σύντονον, θεοφανείας ἀρρήτου ἐδείχθης σάλπιγξ χρυσή, περιούσιον λαὸν τρέφων τοὶς λόγοις σου, τῶν γὰρ πανσόφων σου ᾠδῶν, ἡ πανεύσημος μολπή, εὐφραίνει τὴν Ἐκκλησίαν, δι' ἣν λαμπρῶς ἠγωνίσω, θεομακάριστε Θεόφανες.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος πλ α', Τον συνάναρχον λόγον — the first hymn on the page of «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας», and it names him. The «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» printed under it is the common of a teacher of Orthodoxy and is not drafted.

english.text: Initiated, father, into the intensity of the angels, you were shown to be a golden trumpet of the unutterable manifestation of God, feeding a peculiar people with your words; for the far-famed singing of your all-wise odes gladdens the Church, for which you contended brilliantly, Theophanes blessed of God.

hymns.text: Ἀνεφάνης Ὅσιε, τῇ Ἐκκλησίᾳ ὥσπερ ἄλλος ἥλιος, ταύτην φωτίζων ἀστραπαῖς, τῶν σῶν δογμάτων Θεόφανες, ὣς θυηπόλος, Χριστοῦ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ', Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — on the page of «Όσιος Θεοφάνης ο Γραπτός, ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Νίκαιας», and it names him.

english.text: You appeared to the Church, venerable one, like another sun, lighting her with the lightnings of your doctrines, Theophanes, as a priest of Christ our God.
